title: hm-loop exact runtime report schemas v4

x-api.signature: validate_runtime_report(report_name: str, payload: Mapping[str, Any], expected: ReportExpectationV1) -> ValidatedRuntimeReportV1
rules: reject duplicate JSON keys before schema validation
validate IntegrationManifestV2 source receipt, canonical hash, Git ancestry, commit tree and exact binary diff before constructing trusted ReportExpectationV1
require exact report_name-to-schema mapping and additionalProperties=false
require payload common authority fields equal ReportExpectationV1 exactly; common authority field names are unchanged from report-schemas-v2
bind outer/core integration commit/tree and integration_manifest_sha256 to the already-validated IntegrationManifestV2
for promotion-plan-v3 bind payload outer/core integration commit/tree fields to identical top-level and manifest values
require artifact_count=11 and artifact_hashes keys exactly the 11 active R10 basenames
require counts.collected = counts.executed + counts.skipped; counts.executed = counts.passed + counts.failed; counts.failed = 0
require exit_code = 0 for every command receipt
CI, Desktop, canary and rollback critical gates cannot be skipped
verdict-integrity requires exact R10 authority IDs/profiles/models/providers and identical evidence/topology values
same-provider fallback requires distinct reviewer profiles/models plus identical deterministic suite hashes

x-integration-manifest-v2.canonical_preimage: compact UTF-8 JSON with recursively sorted object keys, preserved array order, no terminal LF, excluding only top-level manifest_sha256
validation_order: reject duplicate keys and validate IntegrationManifestV2 shape
load and hash exact source-receipt-r8.json bytes; require source_receipt_schema and source_receipt_sha256 match
require all four source candidate commit/tree fields equal the loaded receipt
recompute manifest_sha256 from the canonical preimage excluding manifest_sha256

for outer and core: git cat-file commit, merge-base --is-ancestor source integration, require integration commit tree equals declared tree, hash exact source..integration binary diff and run diff --check
only after all source/hash/Git checks construct ReportExpectationV1 and validate report authority

apis.name: validate_integration_manifest
apis.signature: validate_integration_manifest(manifest: IntegrationManifestV2, source_receipt_path: pathlib.Path, repositories: Mapping[str, pathlib.Path]) -> IntegrationManifestV2
